challenges.title: aveGAV VSSU, time premiums and many sites

items.title: aveGAV VSSU & annual target hours
items.text: The generally binding collective labour agreement (GAV) of the private security industry (VSSU) sets categories A/B, each with its own annual target hours — keeping to them across many sites is laborious by hand.

items.title: Time bonus for night and Sunday work
items.text: Night work (23:00–06:00) and work on Sundays and public holidays trigger a time bonus of 10% per hour worked — which has to be credited to the time account on an ongoing basis.

items.title: Many sites, one plan
items.text: Every site has its own posts, times and requirements — keeping track of all of it at once is hardly feasible by hand.

solutions.title: How Klacks takes the load off Swiss security services
solutions.subtitle: From the covered post to the recorded time premium — everything works together.

items.title: Sites & posts without gaps
items.text: Every post across all sites — Klacks shows every open position immediately and fills it automatically on request.

items.title: Time bonus as time credit
items.text: Klacks automatically documents the night and Sunday hours that attract a premium under the aveGAV VSSU and credits the stored 10% time bonus as time credit to your time account.

items.title: 210-hour threshold monitored live
items.text: You store the monthly threshold of 210 hours as a period ceiling — Klacks monitors it live, warns in good time before it is exceeded and, on request, hard-blocks further assignments in automatic planning; with manual planning it stays at a warning. You settle the statutory 25% premium and the compensation within the 3-month period on the basis of the hours documented in this way.

items.title: Certificates checked automatically
items.text: Klacks checks the stored certificates with every assignment and warns in good time before a certificate expires. If a mandatory certificate is missing, Klacks refuses the assignment, in manual planning too; if it has expired, Klacks warns — and, on request, refuses it as well.

items.title: Patrol rounds optimised
items.text: For mobile services, Klacks plans patrol routes so that journeys stay short and intervals are kept.

items.title: Klacksy understands your request
items.text: “Cover the night shift for Site North” is all it takes — Klacksy starts the planning, Klacks checks certificates, availability and the hour limits you have stored.

example.title: Night shift, time bonus, one plan
example.text: Klacks automatically credits the stored time bonus for night and Sunday work as time credit to your time account and monitors the 210-hour threshold live — no manual recalculating.
